name: Cleave
effect: Hits every enemy for 60% of a normal hit

name: Aimed strike
effect: The hero's next hit is a sure crit

name: Flurry
effect: 3 quick hits at 50% each

name: Poison
effect: The target takes damage over 3 rounds (30% of a hit per round)

name: Elemental blast
effect: Hits every enemy for 60% in the hero's element (or the gear's infusion)

name: Smite
effect: ×2 damage on one undead or spirit
trigger: The hero's first turn against an undead or spirit

name: Execute
effect: ×3 damage on an enemy below 25% HP

name: Focus
effect: The hero's next attack ×2

name: Stagger
effect: The strongest enemy loses its next turn

name: Entangle
effect: One enemy loses its next turn

name: Taunt
effect: Every enemy targets this hero for 2 rounds

name: Dirty trick
effect: The boss misses its next attack

name: Distraction
effect: The weakest ally isn't targeted for 1 round

name: Second wind
effect: Heals self 25% of max HP

name: Mana shield
effect: Absorbs the next hit on self

name: Ward
effect: Absorbs the next hit on an ally

name: Vanish
effect: Dodges every attack for 1 round

name: Riposte
effect: Counters the next 2 hits taken
trigger: First time hit in a fight

name: Mend
effect: Heals the weakest ally 20% of max HP

name: Regrowth
effect: The party heals 5% a round for 3 rounds

name: Rally
effect: Party +15% damage for 2 rounds

name: Patch up
effect: The party heals 8% of max HP

name: Steal
effect: An extra loot roll from the boss's row

name: Double or nothing
effect: ×3 damage or a miss (50/50)

name: Meteor
effect: 300% of a hit to the boss

name: Deep freeze
effect: Every enemy loses its next turn

name: Resurrection
effect: A fallen ally returns at 30% HP

name: Banish
effect: Instantly defeats one non-boss undead or spirit
trigger: The hero's first turn against one

name: Summon
effect: A temporary ally for one fight (beast for Beastmaster and Druid; undead for Necromancer)
notes: Separate from the Beastmaster and Necromancer passives

name: Parley
effect: One non-boss enemy leaves the fight (no loot from it)
trigger: First round of a fight with 3+ enemies

name: Feast
effect: Every hero back to full HP

name: Turret
effect: A construct deals 40% of the Engineer's hit each round for 3 rounds
trigger: First round of the boss fight
